title: Drivers Only
description: The fleet driver roster should list exactly the accounts registered with the driver role — nobody with a dispatcher, admin, or customer badge belongs on it.
successCondition: Register one account each for driver, customer, and dispatcher roles with distinct emails. GET /api/fleet/drivers as a dispatcher/admin returns a drivers array that includes the new driver's id/email, but does not include the customer's or dispatcher's id anywhere in the list.
hints: GET /api/fleet/drivers requires a dispatcher or admin token to call at all — register a dispatcher/admin account first to make the call.
Match by id, not just email substring, in case another seeded account happens to share part of the email string.
